description: Main source code for LED driver testing using Zephyr RTOS, including LED color management, device initialization, and test routines for multiple LED controllers.

methods.name: prepare_color_buffer
methods.description: Prepares a color buffer for an LED based on its color mapping and index.

methods.name: run_led_test
methods.description: Runs a sequence of color and brightness tests on a single LED.

methods.name: run_channel_test
methods.description: Runs color and brightness tests on all LEDs via channel write API.

methods.name: run_test
methods.description: Runs tests on all LEDs, including device info display and test routines.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that detects available LED controllers and runs tests.
